name: Leeds City Council

departments.name: Entertainment Licensing
departments.notes: Handles Licensing Act 2003 (alcohol, entertainment, late night refreshment) and Gambling Act 2005 premises. Office hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm. After application submission, blue notice must be displayed at premises for 10 working days. Objection period is 28 days. Applications also sent to West Yorkshire Police at Elland Road.

departments.name: Taxi and Private Hire Licensing
departments.notes: Office hours: Monday-Friday. Drop-in: 9am-12pm. By appointment only: 1pm-3pm. Staff training every third Tuesday until 10am. Quote badge/plate number and DOB when contacting.

departments.name: Property Licensing (HMO)
departments.notes: HMO licensing mandatory for properties with 5+ persons forming 2+ households. Contact before making any licence changes.

departments.name: Selective Licensing
departments.notes: Selective Licensing Scheme from 9 February 2026 to 8 February 2031. Covers parts of Armley, Beeston & Holbeck, Burmantofts & Richmond Hill, Hunslet & Riverside, Gipton & Harehills, Farnley & Wortley wards. Non-compliance penalty: unlimited fine or civil penalty up to £30,000.

departments.name: Markets and Street Trading
departments.notes: Phone hours: 9am-5pm Monday-Saturday. City centre pitches have waiting list - email to register interest. Food vendors need hygiene rating 4 or 5. Events/specialist markets: market.events@leeds.gov.uk

departments.name: Street Cafe (Pavement Licence)
departments.notes: Licence fee: £500. Valid until 31 March annually. Public can comment on applications via council website.

departments.name: Planning
departments.notes: Applications submitted via national Planning Portal. Search and comment on applications via leeds.gov.uk/planning. No direct email for planning applications - use Planning Portal or phone.

departments.name: Building Control
departments.notes: Head of Building Control: David Pickles. Office hours: Mon-Thu 8:30am-5pm, Fri 8:30am-4:30pm. Voicemail outside hours. Currently experiencing substantial delays due to staff shortages - alternative building control providers may be considered. Regularisation only for work completed after 11 November 1985.

departments.name: Highways (Traffic Orders)
departments.notes: TRO objections/representations to Mr R A Hardy at Legal Services. TraffWeb system displays parking places and restrictions. Public consultations on proposed Traffic Management measures available online. Contact for: parking restrictions, bus lanes, moving traffic contraventions.

departments.name: Environmental Health
departments.notes: Handles food safety, statutory nuisance, air quality, odour, pollution (light, dust, smoke). Out of hours noise nuisance: 0113 376 0337 (5pm-3:30am). Also responsible authority for licensing consultations.

departments.name: Child Performance Licensing
departments.notes: Licences and work permits for child performers.

departments.name: Animal Welfare Licensing
departments.notes: Covers pet shops, doggy day care, animal boarding facilities, breeding licences.

researchNotes: Research conducted via Leeds City Council website and web searches. Main council offices at Civic Hall, Calverley Street. Building Control at Merrion House (9th floor) experiencing staff shortages and delays. Selective Licensing Scheme starting Feb 2026 covers 6 wards. Entertainment Licensing handles both Licensing Act 2003 and Gambling Act 2005 applications. West Yorkshire Police (Elland Road) and Fire Service (Oakroyd Hall, Birkenshaw) are key responsible authorities. TraffWeb system used for Traffic Order information and consultations.
